topic: Classifying patterns in short time-series charts

audience.description: New operations analysts who review weekly dashboards
prior_knowledge: Can read whole numbers and percentages
audience.work_context: Classifying dashboard patterns before escalating an operational issue
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone

desired_performance: Classify an unfamiliar short time-series as a trend, anomaly, or insufficient evidence and justify the decision with visible chart cues.

delivery.aesthetic: editorial data visualization with restrained navy, blue, and amber
